JOB OVERVIEW

Looking for another Full Stack .Net/C# Developer for our Valencia, CA 91355 client.

Under the supervision of the IT Development Manager, designs, develops, implements, modifies, and supports software applications and components for core business processes. Works from written specifications and pre-established guidelines to perform the functions of the position while maintaining technical documentation of process flow associated with their work.

JOB ACCOUNTABILITIES
• Under general supervision, implements all aspects of application design – high performance design, coding, caching mechanisms, security, encryption, state management, error logging, debugging, scalability, code reviews, development environment configuration, and testing.
• Participates in every aspect of development and implementation, working with project analysts to ensure full understanding of the implications to business processes.
• Confirms application meets specifications through an objective review process.
• Ensures the best possible performance, quality, and responsiveness of applications.
• Identifies bottlenecks and bugs, logs issues, and recommends solutions to identified issues.
• Helps maintain code quality, organization, and automatization.
• Performs unit and system level testing on applications.
• Develops data migration and integration processes to legacy systems using identified development tools and technologies.

QUALIFICATIONS & REQUIREMENTS:
• Five to seven (5-7) years relevant programming experience, undergraduate degree in computer science, business, or an equivalent combination of education and experience.
• Proficiency in .NET/C# development (+5 years).
• .NET/C# full stack developer experience (+3 years) necessary.
• Experience with Azure Architecture (+3 years) - App Service, Azure Functions, Event Grid, ARM/Bicep, Blob Storage.
• API Development and API Security utilizing OAuth2 and JWT.
• Utilizes established development tools, guidelines and conventions including but not limited to ASP.NET, SQL Server, RabbitMQ, and REST APIs.
• Strong front end experience with JavaScript, TypeScript, jQuery, HTML, CSS, ASP.NET MVC.
• Preferable front-end framework experience with Angular or React.
• Enhance existing systems by analyzing business objectives, preparing an action plan and identifying areas for modification and improvement.
• Creates technical specifications and test plans.
• Excellent understanding of troubleshooting techniques.
• Object-oriented design experience.
• Domain driven design preferred.
• Proficient understanding of code versioning tools such as Git, GitHub, SVN, other tools for Agile SCRUM Sprint scheduling and issue tracking such as Atlassian JIRA and Confluence.

SALARY & BENEFITS:
• $125,000-$145,000 annually
• Medical, Dental, and Vision
• 401(k) with Company Match
• Sick and Vacation Days
• Flexible Spending Account
• Life & Disability Insurance
• Education Assistance
• Employee Referral Program

Career-minded individuals will find our business challenging and our reputation for excellence just one of the rewards we have to offer. To further enhance this tradition of excellence, our employees participate in continuous training and development programs in a variety of disciplines.
